test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

It is your duty to help the poor people in your parish.

options.text: The poor people in your parish are to be helped by you.
It is suggested that you do your duty to help the poor in your parish.
The poor people in the parish are helped by you as duty.
You may be allowed to help the poor people in your parish.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The poor people in your parish are to be helped by you."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice.
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• It + is + Subject + duty + to V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ is/am/are + to be V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *It is my duty to assist my partner. (Active Voice)*
 
• *My partner is to be assisted by me. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The sentence is in active voice with the subject **"you"** performing the action of helping.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object (poor people in your parish) the subject and use the auxiliary verb "to be" along with the past participle form of the main verb (helped).
 
• The preposition **"by"** is used to indicate the doer of the action (you).
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 ​

Correct sentence:* The poor people in your parish are to be helped by you. *
